messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert -> oncall-sre. High SRV lookup failures + 5xx from service discovery observed in eu-west-2. Runbook: /runbooks/srv-resolution-deg

elena: I'm on it. Which clusters/azs are most affected? Any customer-facing errors yet?

matt: infra here. Gateway proxies in eu-west-2b are seeing lots of UDP timeouts to our resolver endpoints (10.200.0.0/24). Consul read latencies spiking and CoreDNS returning SERVFAIL intermittently.

jo: eng-runtime. Sample tail from proxy logs: 
```
2025-01-09T14:02:17Z gateway-proxy[1]: ERROR resolve SRV _svc._tcp.orders.svc.cluster.local: udp timeout to 10.200.3.7:53
2025-01-09T14:02:18Z coredns[2]: [WARN] upstream lookup failed: read udp 10.200.3.7:53->10.200.1.2:53321: i/o timeout
2025-01-09T14:02:19Z app[7]: WARNING using cached endpoints for orders-service (age=124s)
```

disha: cloud network update: Provider reports partial route propagation failure inside Transit Gateway affecting some AZ attachments. They suspect a control-plane race during a recent peering update. Ticket TGW-91999 opened and now P1.

elena: quick mitigation plan: 1) divert resolver traffic to node-local dns sidecar where possible, 2) clear app-level SRV caches, 3) push low TTL for SRV records temporarily, 4) staged CoreDNS pod restarts, 5) failover critical SRV-backed traffic to ALB targets where we can. I'll start steps 1 and 2.

matt: enabling node-local-dns where available and adding iptables REDIRECT on gateway-proxy to point UDP/53 to local resolver. command used: 
```
# on gateway-proxy
iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p udp --dport 53 -j REDIRECT --to-ports 1053
systemctl restart node-local-dns
```

jo: flushed runtime SRV caches and toggled the probe interval for resolver clients. For k8s services we also bumped kube-dns cache TTL to 20s in the injector config. Commands: 
```
kubectl -n kube-system exec deploy/coredns -- /bin/sh -c "s6-svc -t /var/run/s6/services/coredns"
# app-level:
curl -X POST http://internal-config/flush-srv-cache
```

elena: customer impact: CS reports delayed webhook deliveries and sporadic 502s for customers using SRV-based routing in eu-west-2. CS ticket refs: CS-2244, CS-2251. Not a full outage but visible error spike.

customer-success-bot: CS team notified affected customers and posted initial advisory. Status page pending further confirmation.

matt: measurement: SRV resolution success across proxies improved from ~58% -> ~85% after local redirect. Still seeing an error tail (~15%) correlated with attachments that haven't received the TGW route update.

disha: provider says fix is staged; propagation ETA ~30-45m for all attachments. They pushed a hotfix to control plane; monitoring for propagation.

elena: lower SRV TTL to reduce cache-time exposure while propagation completes. Jo, can you apply TTL override and do a rolling restart of CoreDNS (one at a time)?

jo: applied SRV TTL override to 15s in CoreDNS configmap and restarted pods one-by-one. snippet: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: coredns
data:
  corefile: |
    .:53 {
      forward . 10.200.1.2 10.200.1.3 {
        force_tcp
        max_fails 1
      }
      cache 15
    }
```
Rollout: pods 1/4 restarted, no restarts reported in apps.

matt: also increased conntrack table size on gateway-proxy nodes to avoid stale conntrack entries causing UDP packets to be dropped during redirect. sysctl applied across nodes.

elena: keep fallback routing active for highest-priority customers: HAProxy config updated to prefer ALB endpoints when SRV resolution age > 10s.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff: elena -> matt in 25m. Handoff notes saved to the incident doc.

matt: taking watch. I'll keep polling provider ticket TGW-91999 and CS queue. If propagation doesn't finish in 45m we'll prepare to widen ALB failover and run a controlled full CoreDNS recycle.

elena: quick root-cause note for postmortem: probable TGW control-plane propagation race combined with long SRV caches and lack of node-local resolver fallbacks on some proxy fleet members. Mitigations done: node-local redirect, SRV cache flush, TTL override, staged CoreDNS restarts, conntrack tuning, ALB fallback.

customer-success-bot: CS will post update to customers once we confirm full regional convergence.

matt: monitoring: SRV success now ~93% after last restarts and provider convergence on most attachments. Leaving alert in watch mode for 2h. Keep thread for logs and any regression reports. :thumbsup:
